Build kit for "Field"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

Keyword search matched these page templates: form-wizard (@astryxdesign/core), form-wizard-dialog (@astryxdesign/core), form-wizard-vertical (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 4; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        FieldShowcase

description: A form field wrapping a text input with a label, description, and validation status.

name:        InputGroupBasic
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A currency field with static prefix and suffix addons around a TextInput.

name:        TextInputSizes

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 6; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        Field
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Field is a low-level wrapper for custom, native, or third-party controls that do not already provide field label, description, and status UI.

name:        FieldLabel
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Standalone label group for one control or a caller-labelled group, with optional supporting text, optionality indicators, icon, and tooltip.

name:        FieldStatus
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: FieldStatus renders validation feedback for fields and field-like controls.
